title: She Thinks Like a Boss: Leadership—9 Essential Skills for New Female Leaders in Business and the Workplace
author: Jemma Roedel
target_audience: Women entering managerial or supervisory roles
Anyone interested in gender-focused leadership strategies
core_themes: Building confidence as a female leader
primary_purpose: To equip women who are new to leadership roles with practical tools, strategies, and mindsets required to thrive in business, overcome gender-related obstacles, and lead teams with confidence and clarity.

structure_format.organization: Organized by nine distinct leadership skills, each with actionable guidance and anecdotes

key_concepts_lessons: Importance of self-confidence and presence in leadership.
How to communicate assertively and effectively in the workplace.
Strategies for delegating tasks and empowering teams.
Setting healthy boundaries to avoid burnout.
Navigating and challenging workplace bias and stereotypes.
Emotional intelligence as a foundation for leadership.
Building influence and respect within diverse teams.
The value of ongoing personal and professional growth.
notable_features: Nine clearly identified leadership skills tailored to women's workplace experiences
Emphasis on practical application and mindset shifts
Stories and advice specific to female challenges in business
Resources for reflection and further development
cultural_historical_context: Published amidst widespread discussion on gender equality and the 'women in leadership' movement, the book provides context-specific guidance as workplaces strive to address diversity and empower female professionals.
reception_impact: Well-received for its accessible and actionable content
Popular among early-career women and business mentors
Praised for addressing real-world obstacles female leaders face
Acknowledged as a practical complement to broader leadership literature
Some critics wish for more depth in addressing intersectionality and global perspectives
comparable_titles: Lean In: Women, Work, and the Will to Lead by Sheryl Sandberg
Own It: The Power of Women at Work by Sallie Krawcheck
The Confidence Code: The Science and Art of Self-Assurance—What Women Should Know by Katty Kay and Claire Shipman
How Women Rise: Break the 12 Habits Holding You Back from Your Next Raise, Promotion, or Job by Sally Helgesen and Marshall Goldsmith
